name: Mount Meru
intro: At 4,566 metres Mount Meru is Tanzania's second highest peak and a rewarding 3-4 day trek with an armed ranger escort through wildlife-rich forest.
Many climbers do Meru first to prepare for Kilimanjaro.
metaTitle: Mount Meru Trek Tanzania | 3-4 Day Climb | Glad Of Africa
metaDescription: Trek Mount Meru, Tanzania's second highest peak, with an armed ranger and expert guides. Ideal Kilimanjaro acclimatisation.
